## Summary

- What changed and why?

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run lint` (or `npm run lint:scripts`)
- [ ] `npm test` / `npm run playwright test`
- [ ] Relevant manifests regenerated (if widget/portfolio changes)
- [ ] Visual/UX check (screenshots or notes)

## Checklist

- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or workflows changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry added if user-facing
- [ ] No generated files committed (`dist/**`, `manifest.json` outputs)
- [ ] Follows repo standards (widget versioning, scripts in /scripts, no dist edits)

## Notes for reviewers

- Risks, rollout, or follow-ups
